title: QuickBooks invoice payments joined across source relations
evidence: Issue #120 reported that an invoice ID shared by several QuickBooks sources picked up other sources' payment IDs. The merged diff adds source_relation to the invoice_pay join and carries it into downstream joins.
source_sql:
left join invoice_linked
        on invoices.invoice_id = invoice_linked.invoice_id

    where invoice_linked.payment_id is not null
adaptation: Isolates invoice_pay with synthetic inputs, adds a unique invoice row ID for tracing, and omits the invoice estimate and downstream merges. The excerpt comes from a dbt model that requires rendering.
before_sql:
SELECT i.row_id AS id, p.payment_id
FROM invoices AS i LEFT JOIN invoice_linked AS p ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id
WHERE p.payment_id IS NOT NULL
after_sql:
SELECT i.row_id AS id, p.payment_id
FROM invoices AS i LEFT JOIN invoice_linked AS p ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id AND i.source_relation = p.source_relation
WHERE p.payment_id IS NOT NULL
